newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BUILDER UNIBUD SEEKS MAIN MARKET LISTING.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BUILDER UNIBUD SEEKS MAIN MARKET LISTING.

text.p: Polish construction firm Unibud SA will apply to the Warsaw bourse to enter the exchange's main market rather than the parallel floor, as the firm had previously planned, Unibud said in a statement on Thursday.

Unibud, whose January one-million-share initial public offering at 15 zlotys per share was heavily oversubscribed, said it had fulfilled the requirements for a main market listing and would withdraw its parallel market application.
The firm, which before the issue was 49.9-percent owned by Budimex , had planned a bourse debut for late May or early June.
The IPO put Unibud's number of shares outstanding at 1.69 million.
